instruction.name: vldrepl.w
instruction.description: Read 32-bit data from memory address `addr + offset`, replicate the data to all vector lanes and save into `dst`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset, matching the assembly immediate; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vldrepl.w $vr0, $r20, 0; vldrepl.w $vr1, $r20, 4; vldrepl.w $vr2, $r20, 8; vldrepl.w $vr3, $r20, 12; vldrepl.w $vr4, $r20, 16; vldrepl.w $vr5, $r20, 20; vldrepl.w $vr6, $r20, 24; vldrepl.w $vr7, $r20, 28
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'vldrepl.w $vr0, $r20, 0; vldrepl.w $vr1, $r20, 4; vldrepl.w $vr2, $r20, 8; vldrepl.w $vr3, $r20, 12; vldrepl.w $vr4, $r20, 16; vldrepl.w $vr5, $r20, 20; vldrepl.w $vr6, $r20, 24; vldrepl.w $vr7, $r20, 28'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is 64-byte aligned; unaligned LASX loads/stores are substantially slower.

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot, 64-byte-aligned 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
